title: Comparative benchmark campaign
description: Objective: execute the blinded paired campaign, usability study, cost accounting, and permit-list claim decisions exactly as preregistered. Deliverable: reproducible per-run records, analyses, and scoped release template. NOT in scope: marketing reinterpretation or cross-basis imputation. Hard dependency: Confirmatory corpus freeze. Owned paths: immutable campaign outputs and release evidence only. Verification: benchmark decision-rule checker.
definitionOfDone: All required Moe/comparator arms, repetitions, oracles, receipts, raters, and user-study cases complete or are classified by the frozen censoring rules.
Every L1-L5 gate prints PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN with correct tails, multiplicity, margins, and comparator indexing.
Cost, acceptance, effort, speed, quality, overhead, and safety statements remain within the permit list.
taskRails: Claims follow the benchmark permit-list; missing, partial, cross-basis, or unverifiable evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS.
No confirmatory corpus is generated or viewed until the implementation commit is frozen exactly as specified.
GO_QUIESCE and GO_ACTIVATE are separate human decisions. Keep evidence exact, reproducible, and scoped to one source commit.
